messages:
release-bot: Weekly release-train bulletin — quick summary and a couple policy updates before this sprints rollout. Key points: 1) Soft freeze for feature merges starts 2025-07-14 20:00 UTC; 2) Canary weighting will default to 10% for feature rollouts and 25% for infra rollouts; 3) New rollback-window policy: if a canary shows >3% user error rate increase over baseline within 30m, auto-rollback will trigger. Read the checklist below and ping the release triage channel for exemptions.

emma: Changelog highlights: v4.0.0-alpha: improved batching heuristic, KV cache compaction opt, and reduced llama-tokenizer memory footprint; infra: autoscaler tweak to reduce pod churn; docs: updated Dedicated deploy checklist. Small compatibility note: quant-plugin v2.1 changes config keys `quant.level` -> `quant.profile` (backwards shim included).

raj: Canary status: were running early-stage canaries for the batching heuristic on us-central-1 at 10% traffic. So far P50/P95 unchanged, cost-per-token down ~6%. Will promote to 25% if stable at 6 hours.

sgt-oncall: Reminder about the new rollback-window: monitoring hooks must include the user-error metric and datastore-ops latency. If your change touches serialization or model-init, add the flag `sensitive-init=true` to the PR and expect tighter scrutiny.

theo: Ops notes: temporary hold for any feature that adds new model-loading paths to the runtime. If you need to land such a change pre-freeze, open a `runtime-load-exempt` ticket and attach load-test results from staging. We had one OOM cluster yesterday due to an untested loader path.

carol: Customer impact callout: we have two enterprise customers on Dedicated with heavy 50k TPS bursts; ops will coordinate targeted canaries scoped to their regions — please include regional canary plans in PR descriptions.

emma: Quick PR checklist snippet for this freeze:
```
- add label `release-train-2025-07`
- include canary plan: regions, % traffic, duration
- attach staging pre-warm logs if model >1GB
- list rollback steps and expected downtime
```

raj: Note on metrics: baseline windows are rolling 24h. Use `release-dashboard` query: `err_rate{path="/generate"} offset 24h` to compare.

release-bot: Exemptions: security fixes and P0/P1 incident patches are still allowed but must have both SRE and security approval. To request exemption use: `/freeze-exempt PR-#### --approvers sreg.lead,sec.lead --reason "brief reason"`. Exemptions expire after 12h unless extended.

sgt-oncall: If you push an exempt change, add `--audit freeze-2025-07` to the approval command and paste the output to the release ticket. Ops will auto-collect audit logs.

carol: Executive note: VP Eng asked us to prioritize reliability metrics for next quarter. This freeze window is meant to stabilize infra before the customer demo week. Please respect the freeze and help triage any exempt requests quickly.

emma: Ill post the full canary dashboard link and a brief pre-freeze checklist in #release-dashboard in 30m. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Follow-up summary will be posted 2025-07-15 09:00 UTC with final canary readouts and any exemption decisions.
